params.body:
## Summary

Four small, related fixes in the Stocklist browser filter panel (`resources/views/livewire/stocklist-browser.blade.php`, `app/Livewire/StocklistBrowser.php`):

1. **Spacing.** The "Premium trader-aanbod tonen" switch sat almost flush under the "+ Meer filters" button (collapsed: ~6px gap; expanded: ~13px) because the button's `margin-bottom` and the toggle's own margin collapsed to whichever was larger, never summed. `.ui-toggle` now carries `margin-top: 16px`, which always wins the collapse, so the gap is a consistent 16px regardless of whether the panel is expanded. `.ui-switch` also grew from `min-height: 22px` to `44px` for a real tap target; it already had `align-items: center`, so a two-line label (it wraps at the panel's fixed width even on desktop) now centers the switch across both lines instead of pinning it to the first.

2. **Price range.** "Inkoopprijs" (`trade_price`) was two `<select>`s with 23 fixed, densely-packed steps topping out at €100.000. Reduced to 16 coarser steps (500 through 200.000), then extended the same way `mileageList()` already extends kilometerstand: growing €50.000 at a time until one step sits above the highest `trade_price` actually in the dealer-visible stock (cached under `sl_trade_price_max`, same TTL as the existing `sl_mileage_max`). No blade change was needed — the selects already loop over whatever `priceList()` returns, and `trade_price.from`/`trade_price.to` (the Livewire properties and querystring) are untouched, so a bookmarked filter link keeps working.

   I did not build a histogram slider for this field. The only "facets" with a 24-bucket price distribution I could find are in the **public website API** (`PublicVehicleController@facets`, `app/Http/Controllers/Api/Public/`), a different consumer with different price semantics (`PublicWebsitePrice`, not `trade_price`) — nothing in `StocklistBrowser.php` computes a price histogram today, unlike bouwjaar/kilometerstand which already have one. Building and wiring a new histogram for this screen would have been a real feature, not a focused fix, so I took the documented fallback (fewer, growing steps) instead.

3. **Model counts.** The "Merk"-select already showed "Audi (34)"; the "model"-select under it didn't. Added `$modelCountsByRow` per manufacturer row (same light proxy and cache shape as `$manufacturerCounts`: group + manufacturer + the base stocklist-availability filters, not every active filter), rendered as "(n)" next to each model name. Placeholder stays "model".

4. **Checkbox-group counts + hide zero.** "Type brandstof" (and the four other lists that share the `<x-ui.checklist>` component: Transmissie, Carrosserievorm, Kleur, Lak) now show "(n)" and hide a value with 0 vehicles — unless it's already checked, so an existing filter (e.g. from a bookmarked link) never disappears out from under someone with no way to uncheck it. New optional `:counts`/`:selected` props on `x-ui.checklist`; a new `checklistFacetCounts()` helper on the component computes each list's counts with the same base-filter shape as `$manufacturerCounts` (Carrosserievorm needed an extra join since it filters on `body_style_group_id`, which lives on `vehicle_body_styles`, not `vehicles`). I did **not** touch the sixth user of `<x-ui.checklist>`, the per-option checkboxes inside "Opties" (`option.{id}`): those are already an N+1 risk the code goes out of its way to avoid (the existing `sl_options` cache comment says so), and a facet-count query per option value would undo that saving.

## Why bundled

Same file, same panel, same PR per the coordinator's instructions as the scope grew mid-task.

## Screenshots

- `.playwright-mcp/stocklist-filter-toggle/before-390-open.png` / `after-390-open.png` — spacing, 390px, panel expanded
- `.playwright-mcp/stocklist-filter-toggle/before-1440.png` / `after-1440-final.png` — spacing, 1440px
- `.playwright-mcp/stocklist-filter-toggle/item34-390.png` — model counts ("A1 (6)"/"A3 (2)" in the accessibility tree; the native `<select>` popup itself can't be screenshotted open) and brandstof counts/hide-zero ("Benzine (4)", "Diesel (4)", Elektrisch absent) at 390px
- `.playwright-mcp/stocklist-filter-toggle/item234-1440.png` — same at 1440px, plus the price select showing the new range (up to € 950.000 given a seeded € 900.000 car)

`own-stock-list.blade.php`'s "Meer filters" (line ~145) does **not** share this pattern: its button is followed by a `wf-grid` of fields, not a `.ui-switch` toggle, so there was nothing to align there.

## Tests

`vendor/bin/phpunit --filter="Stocklist|StylesheetSyntax|AlpineExpression|RulesCoverage|RulesIdentity|OwnStockList"` — 61 passed, 792 assertions (run on a fresh schema + migrations, cold cache; this repo's test suite runs on the file cache, not the array store `phpunit.xml` asks for — `config/cache.php` reads `CACHE_DRIVER`, not `CACHE_STORE` — so several new tests `Cache::forget()` their keys first, matching the existing pattern in `WarmCachesTest`).

New/changed in `tests/Feature/StocklistBrowserTest.php`:
- `test_stocklist_browser_can_set_a_trade_price_filter` — `trade_price.from`/`.to` still work as Livewire properties.
- `test_price_steps_reach_above_the_priciest_vehicle_in_stock` — a €260.000 vehicle pushes the highest step to €300.000 and the list stays under 23 entries.
- `test_model_select_shows_a_count_per_model` — a model with one vehicle renders "Telmodel (1)".
- `test_fuel_checklist_hides_zero_unless_checked` — a fuel type with only a *sold* vehicle (present in the base list, 0 in the scoped facet count) is hidden; the same fuel type, checked, stays visible as "(0)".
params.title: Stocklist filter panel: switch spacing, price steps, and per-value counts
